content: ydotool on Ubuntu 24.04: distro package is 0.1.8-3build1 (client opens /dev/uinput directly, no daemon needed; /dev/uinput is root:input 0660 - needs input group or udev ACL for non-root). Upstream 1.0.4 requires ydotoold daemon + socket (not packaged in Ubuntu 24.04). e2e stand: use distro 0.1.8, ensure test user in input group or udev rule; ydotool key <code>:<state> and ydotool type inject via uinput = physical path through evdev/keyd/libinput/compositor/GTK/IBus as required by spec 7.2.
